tools.name: fiken_get_user
tools.description: The Fiken user this connection acts as (name and email). A cheap check that the sign-in works. Fiken: GET /user.

tools.name: fiken_list_companies
tools.description: The Fiken companies this connection can access, with their slug (needed as companySlug in every other tool), organization number and VAT type. Companies created after you approved access must be added under Fiken > Rediger konto > Sikkerhet > Apper du har gitt tilgang til. Fiken: GET /companies.

tools.name: fiken_get_company
tools.description: One company: name, organization number, VAT type, address, accounting start date and whether the API module is active. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}.

tools.name: fiken_list_accounts
tools.description: The bookkeeping accounts (kontoplan) of the current year. Filter with range, e.g. "3000-3999, 1920". Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/accounts.

tools.name: fiken_get_account_balances
tools.description: Closing balance of every bookkeeping account on a date (amounts in cents). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/accountBalances.

tools.name: fiken_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts as registered in Fiken. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/bankAccounts.

tools.name: fiken_get_bank_balances
tools.description: Bank account balances, optionally on a given date (amounts in cents). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/bankBalances.

tools.name: fiken_list_contacts
tools.description: Customers and suppliers. Filter by name, organization number, email, customer/supplier flag or modification date. contactId in the result is the id other tools take as customerId/contactId. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/contacts.

tools.name: fiken_get_contact
tools.description: One customer or supplier with address, contact persons, notes and account codes. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: fiken_list_invoices
tools.description: Issued (final) invoices with sale lines, amounts in cents and settled status. Filter by issue date, due date, customer and whether settled. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/invoices.

tools.name: fiken_get_invoice
tools.description: One issued invoice with lines, customer, amounts in cents, settled status and payment/credit-note links. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: fiken_list_invoice_drafts
tools.description: Drafts of invoices, offers, order confirmations and credit notes that are not issued yet (a draft has a draftId, an invoice has an invoiceId). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/drafts.

tools.name: fiken_list_credit_notes
tools.description: Issued credit notes. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/creditNotes.

tools.name: fiken_list_offers
tools.description: Issued offers (tilbud). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/offers.

tools.name: fiken_list_order_confirmations
tools.description: Issued order confirmations. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/orderConfirmations.

tools.name: fiken_list_products
tools.description: The product register with unit price in cents, income account and VAT type. productId is what an invoice-draft line takes. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/products.

tools.name: fiken_get_product
tools.description: One product. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: fiken_list_sales
tools.description: Sales registered without an invoice (cash, card, Vipps and other direct sales), with amounts in cents. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/sales.

tools.name: fiken_get_sale
tools.description: One sale with lines, payments and settlement status. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/sales/{saleId}.

tools.name: fiken_list_purchases
tools.description: Purchases and supplier bills with amounts in cents and paid status. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/purchases.

tools.name: fiken_get_purchase
tools.description: One purchase with lines, payments and attachments list. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/purchases/{purchaseId}.

tools.name: fiken_list_journal_entries
tools.description: General-ledger journal entries (bilag) with their postings. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/journalEntries.

tools.name: fiken_list_transactions
tools.description: Ledger transactions (one per bookkeeping event) with their entries. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/transactions.

tools.name: fiken_list_projects
tools.description: Projects with number, name and completion status. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/projects.

tools.name: fiken_list_time_entries
tools.description: Registered hours (Fiken Timeføring). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/timeEntries.

tools.name: fiken_list_inbox_documents
tools.description: Documents waiting in the company's inbox (receipts and bills uploaded for bookkeeping). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/inbox.

tools.name: fiken_create_contact
tools.description: Create a customer and/or supplier contact. Set customer=true to invoice it later. The new contactId comes back in `id`. Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/contacts.

tools.name: fiken_create_product
tools.description: Add a product or service to the product register, for use on invoice lines. incomeAccount is a revenue account such as 3000 (see fiken_list_accounts). Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/products.

tools.name: fiken_create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Create a DRAFT of an invoice, offer or order confirmation. A draft is not issued, not booked and not sent; it can be edited or deleted in Fiken. The draft's id comes back in `id`. To issue it use fiken_issue_invoice_from_draft (type invoice only). Amounts are integers in cents. Fiken: POST /companie

tools.name: fiken_issue_invoice_from_draft
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE. Turns an invoice draft into a real invoice: it gets the next invoice number and is booked in the ledger (accounts receivable and revenue, VAT). An issued invoice cannot be deleted, only corrected with a credit note. It is NOT sent to the customer: use fiken_send_invoice for that. Only

tools.name: fiken_send_invoice
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE. Delivers an issued invoice to the customer by email, EHF, eFaktura, SMS or physical letter (a letter costs extra and goes to Norwegian addresses only). A sent message cannot be recalled and Fiken records the invoice as sent. Only call this when the user has clearly asked to send this e

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fiken_get_user, fiken_list_contacts, fiken_list_invoices, fiken_list_inbox_documents · Private data: fiken_list_contacts, fiken_get_contact, fiken_list_inbox_documents, fiken_create_contact, fiken_send_invoice · Public sink: fiken_get_user, fiken_list_contacts, fiken_create_contact, fiken_create_product, fiken_create_invoice_draft, fiken_issue_invoice_from_draft, fiken_send_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fiken_get_user, fiken_list_contacts, fiken_list_invoices, fiken_list_inbox_documents · Private data: fiken_list_contacts, fiken_get_contact, fiken_list_inbox_documents, fiken_create_contact, fiken_send_invoice · Public sink: fiken_get_user, fiken_list_contacts, fiken_create_contact, fiken_create_product, fiken_create_invoice_draft, fiken_issue_invoice_from_draft, fiken_send_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
